h: NLC gives government until 27 October on fuel price and minimum wage
p: The Nigeria Labour Congress has reportedly handed the federal government a four-day deadline to cut fuel prices and review the minimum wage. The union is said to be warning of possible action if nothing is done by 27 October.
more: Depots have lately lowered petrol and diesel rates.
Government has not yet replied to the ultimatum.
